## Installation

Download the latest build for your platform from the assets below:

| Platform              | Format                  |
| --------------------- | ----------------------- |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `.dmg`                  |
| macOS (Intel)         | `.dmg`                  |
| Windows               | `.exe` (NSIS installer) |
| Linux                 | `.AppImage` / `.deb`    |

**macOS (Homebrew):**

```bash
brew install thedavidweng/tap/openkara
```

**Windows (winget):**

```bash
winget install thedavidweng.OpenKara
```

Official macOS releases from v0.16.2 are signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple.
